payload.title: Python newsroom unit tests: stale assertions against current references/tavily/relations/entity-graph/cloud-procedure code
payload.description: Found by PPY-302a5f. Modules failing on develop (also in CI): test_references_commands (10), test_tavily_research (2), test_relations_commands (2), test_analysis_entity_graph_bridge (1: fake first_pass_apply lacks max_parallel kwarg), test_cloud_procedure_execution (2: expects 'papyrus procedures seed-required --apply', code says 'poetry run papyrus procedures seed-required'). Decide per failure: update stale assertion or fix regressed code. Excluded from tests.yml until fixed.
